headline: Zero idle replicas.
detail: One HTTP call wakes your API.
voice: Why keep an API running all night for one morning request?

headline: Keep your HTTP handler.
detail: The first caller waits for a ready worker.
voice: Call your existing endpoint through SlimFaas. It wakes a worker and returns your handler’s answer.

headline: Queue the burst.
detail: Callers get HTTP 202 once their work is queued.
voice: Thirty calculations arrived at once. The callers could move on while four workers shared the load.

headline: Give the capacity back.
detail: All the work is done. The idle timer expires.
voice: All thirty finished. The workers scaled back to zero.

headline: lower infrastructure costs
voice: One team reported cutting its infrastructure costs by more than sixty percent.

headline: Try it with one HTTP endpoint.
voice: Try SlimFaas locally with one of your own HTTP endpoints.
